runtime.capture.title: GifOS is capturing {what}
runtime.capture.forApp: for {label} — it receives only this clip, never your live {device}.
runtime.capOff: You turned {what} off for this app. Turn it back on in the Abilities panel (the chip at the top of the app’s tab).
runtime.busy.sub: {elapsed} so far{mode, select, usually { · usually about {expect}} longer { · longer than its usual {expect}} cold { · first answer loads the model, so it is the slow one} other {}}
runtime.busy.oneTime: One-time download of this app’s data…
runtime.busy.dataFailed: App data download failed — {msg}. The app opens without it and tries again next launch.
runtime.name.title: {app} wants to change your name
runtime.hostbot.title: {app} wants to join every meeting you host
runtime.hostbot.body: Whenever you host a meeting on this device, {app} opens and joins it as a bot named {name}. It records each speaker for a transcript, and everyone in the meeting sees that it is recording.
runtime.hostbot.consent: You're responsible for getting consent to record where the law requires it.
runtime.name.set: Your name on this computer would become {name}. Meetings here show it, and so do apps you let see it.
runtime.name.clear: It would clear the name you use on this computer. Meetings here, and apps you let see your name, would see you as unnamed.
runtime.avatar.title: {app} wants to change your picture
runtime.avatar.set: This picture would be saved on this computer, next to your name. Every app and meeting here would see it.
runtime.avatar.clear: It would remove the picture you use on this computer. Every app and meeting here would see you without it.
runtime.setup.aiBody: This app uses an AI model you provide. In GifOS {settings}, set up {what} — any OpenAI-compatible endpoint and key, or a {provider} from your Providers folder (answers on this device, no key).
runtime.setup.outsideBody: {name} serves {type}, but its icon isn’t in the {folder} folder on your Home Screen. A provider only works from inside that folder (it wears a red ✕ anywhere else) — move it back, or pick another model in {settings}.
runtime.setup.missingBody: {name} is assigned to {type}, but its file is no longer on this computer. Re-install it from the App Store, or pick another model in {settings}.
runtime.setup.apiBody: In GifOS {settings}, add one named {name}{hasUrl, select, yes {, base URL {url}} other {}}{hasAuth, select, yes {, {auth} auth} other {}}.
runtime.setup.keyStays: Your key stays in this browser — the app never sees it.
runtime.handoff.planNever: No account numbers, no institution names, and none of your transactions.
runtime.handoff.field.illiquid: Property and other things you own
runtime.handoff.title: Hand this to your other apps?
runtime.handoff.ask: {app} wants to put {what} where your other apps can pick it up.
runtime.handoff.whole: That is the whole of it — {never} It stays on this device, and only an app that asks for this exact kind of summary can read it.
runtime.splash.openingApp: Opening {name}{big, select, yes { — unpacking {mb} MB…} other {…}}
runtime.status.notFound: File not found on this desktop.
runtime.status.locked: This app is passkey-locked on this device. Unlock it with your passkey to open.
runtime.status.notApp: Not a GifOS app — nothing to run.

runtime.share.body: {app} can then show them, for example beside what you write. Other apps don't get this answer. You can change it later in this app's Abilities.
